# RagaDL v3.5.0 Release Notes

**Release date:** June 2026  
**Upgrade path:** From v3.1.0 to v3.5.0

This release brings a substantial product update across discovery, downloads, favorites, UI polish, and internal architecture. The version jump is appropriate because the changes include multiple backward-compatible feature additions and broad improvements, which aligns with Semantic Versioning guidance for a minor release, while professional changelog guidance recommends grouping notable changes into sections such as Added, Changed, Fixed, and Removed for clarity.

> ## Highlights

- Introduced a more capable multi-site downloader with support for Ragalahari, Idlebrain, and Behindwoods, including pagination-aware scraping and improved bulk download notifications.
- Revamped key user-facing areas such as Latest pages, Favorites, Gallery Links, and Celebrity List with better UI consistency, stronger performance, and cleaner interactions.
- Reworked major app modules into cleaner feature-based layers with Riverpod-powered state management for better scalability and maintainability.

> ## Added

> > ### New features
- Added carousel sections across latest pages to surface recent updates more prominently at the top of the app.
- Added a Latest Events option to download the newest event gallery images.
- Added star-based favorite toggles to Latest tabs including Celebrities, Actors, and Actresses, with saved items routed into the Galleries section.
- Added search recommendations in celebrity profiles instead of direct search, with paginated loading capped at 50 items per page.
- Added shimmer loading for the history list view to improve perceived loading quality.
- Added immersive mode support to reduce the bottom blank area and improve full-screen app presentation.
- Added more color palettes and refined top bar styling for a more polished look.
- Added app name and app version labeling for ABI build version names.

>> ### Downloader expansion
- Added Idlebrain gallery image downloading with direct link paste support.
- Added Behindwoods gallery scraping support with paginated page ranges, chunked concurrent crawling, dynamic range controls, and site-specific thumbnail handling.
- Added a supported-sites information list in the downloader UI for ragalahari.com, idlebrain.com, and behindwoods.com.
- Added a dynamic info button and range-limit guidance for Behindwoods links in the downloader flow.

> ## Changed

>> ### UI and experience
- Increased gallery sizing in latest sections for stronger visual emphasis.
- Introduced auto-hiding app bars on the home page and celebrity pages for a more immersive browsing experience.
- Redesigned the Favorites > Galleries tab into a cleaner grid layout with Show Galleries actions and top-insertion for newly favorited items.
- Updated the search bar design to match the newer visual language across the app.
- Adjusted overlay styling in the image viewer by replacing heavy blur effects with cleaner solid overlays.
- Refined the history page for faster loading, stronger empty-gallery handling, and a better overall browsing flow.

>> ### Performance and behavior
- Improved rendering performance for favorites and the image viewer.
- Moved celebrity favorites loading from async builders to state-driven updates for faster UI feedback and smoother scrolling.
- Increased maximum image zoom to 15x.
- Improved downloader notification behavior for bulk downloads, with pause, resume, and cancel flow still in progress.
- Updated downloader URL handling and notification listener behavior for more reliable download operations.

>> ### Architecture and codebase
- Migrated major feature flows to Riverpod-based state management to improve scalability and state handling.
- Refactored Downloader, Gallery Links, Celebrity List, and Latest modules into cleaner feature-based structures with separate UI, logic, models, controllers, widgets, and utilities where applicable.
- Consolidated shared UI pieces such as search bars, error views, and celebrity cards into reusable common widgets to reduce duplication.
- Unified favorites handling into a shared common favorites service.
- Generalized parser behavior through a shared SiteParser interface and ParserFactory-based support checks, removing hardcoded site-specific branching from downloader logic.

> ## Fixed

- Fixed the pixelized error in link history updates.
- Fixed Show Galleries button issues in the Latest pages.
- Fixed async context problems by adding mounted checks after async gaps.
- Fixed duplicate-code issues across shared widgets and latest page components.
- Fixed slower-network Dio exception cases affecting downloads.
- Reduced UI jank, memory leaks, and CPU spikes by optimizing favorites checks, download task state updates, isolate concurrency, and image viewer lifecycle handling.
- Cleaned lint warnings, removed stale imports, and resolved unused or unreachable code paths.

> ## Removed

- Removed unnecessary Linux and web app versions from the project distribution targets.
- Removed unused analysis report files and other dead code artifacts.
- Removed redundant localized widget implementations after moving to shared common components.
- Removed heavy FutureBuilder-based favorite status checks from gallery grids in favor of synchronous controller-driven state.

> ## Developer notes

Although the visible version jump from v3.1.0 to v3.5.0 may look modest, the release packages several months of user-facing features, UX improvements, performance work, and structural refactors into one backward-compatible update, which fits a minor-version increment under semantic versioning rather than a patch release.

> ## Suggested store summary

RagaDL v3.5.0 introduces a major quality update with new latest-page carousels, expanded multi-site downloading, redesigned favorites, smoother browsing performance, and a cleaner Riverpod-powered architecture. Users should notice faster interactions, improved stability, and a more polished gallery experience throughout the app.

# Pixchive v1.5.0 Release Notes

**Release date:** June 2026  
**Upgrade path:** From v1.1 to v1.5.0

Pixchive v1.5.0 is a major product step forward that evolves the app from a simpler image browser into a more complete comic-plus-gallery experience with smoother interactions, modern Material You styling, stronger media tools, and a far more polished navigation flow. A structured release note format with grouped sections such as Added, Changed, Fixed, and Removed is widely recommended because changelogs should be curated for humans rather than copied from raw commit history.

> ## Highlights

- Expanded Pixchive into a more complete comic and gallery app with modern Material 3 and Material You inspired interactions across browsing, viewing, search, and settings.
- Introduced major gallery capabilities such as All Images mode, global search, recycle bin support, rename tools, richer metadata, multi-selection, and persistent pinch-to-zoom layouts.
- Improved smoothness and stability through paging, background-thread work, optimized thumbnail loading, recomposition fixes, memory improvements, and ANR prevention work.

> ## Added

>> ### New features
- Added a full **All Images** gallery mode so users can browse their device photos in one date-grouped stream instead of only folder-based views.
- Added global image search with real-time suggestions, dedicated search results, and smoother transitions across gallery screens.
- Added a recycle bin workflow with restore and permanent delete support.
- Added rename support for both images and folders with a dedicated rename dialog.
- Added multi-selection support for folders and images with long-press activation and bulk actions.
- Added select-all actions for folders and images.
- Added direct share utilities for single and multiple images.
- Added image information surfaces across the app, including detailed metadata and EXIF-focused information dialogs.
- Added a custom Home option to make the home screen more dynamic.
- Added live scrubbing previews for folder images to make fast-forward style browsing feel more interactive.

>> ### Viewer and browsing tools
- Added immersive mode support in the image viewer for a cleaner edge-to-edge experience.
- Added shared element transitions from grid items into the image viewer for smoother opening animations.
- Added a premium gallery viewer flow with pan, zoom, double-tap behavior, subsampling, and pager-based image navigation.
- Added gallery media actions such as Share, Copy to Clipboard, Edit, and Move to Trash from the image viewer.
- Added a toggleable blur setting for the viewer background with persistence through app settings.
- Added persistent pinch-to-zoom grid sizing so gallery cell preferences remain saved across navigation and app restarts.

>> ### Settings and personalization
- Added six new app color palettes inspired by your broader design system direction.
- Added theme selection for Light, Dark, and System Default modes.
- Added a transparent navigation bar option.
- Added language selection support with first-language guidance.
- Added gallery view settings to control field visibility on folder and image cards.
- Added a rotary sort wheel and expanded sorting support for filename, date, size, resolution, path, and file type.

> ## Changed

>> ### UI and design
- Replaced standard DropdownMenus with Material 3 bottom option sheets throughout the app to improve mobile usability and match a modern bottom-driven interaction pattern.
- Upgraded image details from a dialog into a premium Material 3 modal bottom sheet with grouped metadata presentation.
- Refreshed the Comic Reader screen so it visually aligns better with the gallery image viewer.
- Updated folder and image cards in both grid and list modes with richer metadata, clearer hierarchy, and more polished Material-styled layouts.
- Refined Home Screen browsing with a HorizontalMultiBrowseCarousel for history cards and dynamic entry points into the gallery.
- Changed comic section grid density from 6 to 4 columns for better readability and touch comfort.
- Updated multiple top bars, overlays, and system navigation surfaces to better support transparent and edge-to-edge layouts.

>> ### Navigation and structure
- Refactored gallery browsing into a unified pager-based flow between Albums and Photos, with saved default-tab behavior and better state restoration.
- Merged and cleaned screen structures such as FolderViewScreen and related folder flows to simplify the browsing experience.
- Refactored settings into clearer dedicated folders and improved the overall project organization.
- Implemented type-safe navigation and improved route handling across the independent gallery architecture.
- Reworked gallery navigation so Albums and All Images behave as synchronized parallel browse modes without backstack clutter.

>> ### Performance and responsiveness
- Integrated Paging 3 and moved heavy file I/O work off the main thread to improve responsiveness.
- Optimized grid image loading, thumbnail fetching, and memory handling to reduce lag, stutter, and out-of-memory risk.
- Reduced unnecessary recompositions in gallery lists and grids for smoother scrolling behavior.
- Improved thumbnail and grid rendering behavior to better support pinch-to-zoom transitions and dense browsing views.
- Swapped older blur and image viewing approaches for more stable native or better-optimized alternatives.

> ## Fixed

- Fixed a misclick issue in AllImagesScreen.
- Fixed saved preference behavior for restoring the default browse screen between Albums and Photos.
- Fixed the top bar title in ImageFolderScreen so it now shows the actual folder name instead of a generic label.
- Fixed Window and system UI state leaks in the media viewer.
- Fixed lag and stutter when navigating back from the image viewer to image browsing screens.
- Fixed grid selection issues and improved long-press selection behavior.
- Fixed pinch-zoom grid issues where cells were cropped or scrolling broke during zoom transitions.
- Fixed storage explorer overlay and layout issues around top bars, bottom bars, and selection sheets.
- Fixed settings-sheet mapping issues so grid column selections persist correctly.
- Fixed ANR and database lock contention during folder sync by reducing write pressure and improving cancellation safety.
- Fixed optimistic deletion flows so removed media updates immediately across gallery views.
- Fixed various unresolved references, syntax issues, and compile-time problems in settings and image viewer flows.
- Fixed the issue where favorite images were not showing correctly.

> ## Removed

- Removed excessive zoom behavior from AllImagesScreen for a more controlled browsing experience.
- Removed horizontal and vertical scroll bars from ImageViewScreen for a cleaner full-screen viewer.
- Removed older drag-select behavior for now to avoid unstable interaction patterns before a future reintroduction.
- Removed legacy video-player oriented UI, models, overlays, and dependencies while transforming the experience into image-first gallery components.
- Removed older duplicate or overly heavy gallery files that were adding unnecessary complexity to list and grid layouts.

> ## Architecture and developer improvements

- Built an independent gallery architecture in multiple phases to keep the standard device gallery separated from the SAF-based comic reader flow.
- Introduced gallery-specific domain models, repository flows, dedicated ViewModels, and cleaner screen routing to improve maintainability.
- Refactored media actions, settings sheets, selection helpers, and gallery components into more reusable and modular structures.
- Improved real-time MediaStore observation so the UI reacts faster to device media changes.

> ## Suggested release summary

Pixchive v1.5.0 transforms the app into a richer comic and gallery experience with modern Material 3 design, global image search, All Images mode, recycle bin support, smarter viewer tools, persistent pinch zoom layouts, and major smoothness improvements throughout the app. This kind of backward-compatible feature-heavy jump is consistent with a minor-version release under semantic versioning, especially when the update adds substantial capability without being framed as a breaking rewrite.

# PixChive v1.1

We are excited to release PixChive v1.1.0! This update focuses heavily on polishing the user interface, giving you more control over your reading experience, and squashing several annoying bugs. 

Here is everything new and improved in this version:

### UI & User Experience Enhancements
* **New Rotary Sorting Wheel:** We've introduced a brand-new, rotary-designed sorting wheel. It looks great and provides a much better user experience with plenty of sorting options to organize your library.
* **Refreshed Display Options:** The Display Options sheet has been updated with a newly adjusted layout and a cleaner UI.
* **Settings & Theming:** The Settings screen has received a UI overhaul. You now have the freedom to choose between the app's default theme or your device's dynamic theme.
* **Custom Volume Controls:** Added a new custom toggle so you can change how the volume buttons behave while using the app.
* **Smoother App Loading:** We've made several adjustments under the hood to make the overall loading experience feel noticeably smoother and more responsive.
* **Updated About Page & Privacy:** The About page has been revamped to include proper links to our GitHub and Telegram, alongside your device info. We have also added a dedicated Privacy Policy section.

### Advanced Developer Features
* **Hidden Developer Mode:** You can now unlock Developer Mode! Simply tap the app version 8 times in the Settings screen. Once enabled, you can access a dedicated Log Screen to view app errors and warnings, making troubleshooting much easier.

### Bug Fixes & Performance
* **Webtoon Mode Fix:** Solved a bug in Webtoon mode that was causing unexpected image quality loss.
* **Accurate Chapter Navigation:** Fixed an annoying issue where chapters from a previously viewed folder would mistakenly appear in the present one.
* **Background Image Loading:** Optimized how images are fetched. New images will now load quietly in the background without interfering or mingling with the active UI.
* **Shimmer Adjustments:** Tweaked and adjusted the shimmer loading animations to look more natural.

Thank you for using PixChive! If you encounter any issues or have feature requests, feel free to reach out to us on our GitHub or Telegram channels.

## This is the first official release of PixChive!

I built PixChive to solve a specific problem: viewing massive local image archives and reading downloaded manga or comics chapter-by-chapter without dealing with slow load times or cluttered interfaces.

It is a completely offline, mobile-first Android app built natively with Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. A major focus during development was ensuring smooth scrolling and efficient memory management, so the app can comfortably handle thousands of high-resolution images without lagging.

**What's included in this release:**

- **Folder-based Navigation:** Directly browse your local storage exactly how you organized it.

- **Dedicated Reading Modes:** Includes standard pagination, Webtoon-style vertical scrolling, and right-to-left Manga reading directions.

- **Offline-First:** No accounts, no tracking, and no internet required. Everything stays on your device.

- **Fast & Native:** Built with an MVVM architecture using modern Android APIs (MediaStore/File) for snappy folder scanning and rendering.

**Installation:**
Download the app-release.apk file from the assets below and install it directly on your Android device.

If you encounter any bugs or have feature requests, please feel free to open an issue. Contributions are always welcome.

# Nosved Player v1.0.0 Release Notes

**Release date:** 10 June 2026  
**Initial release:** First official public release of the full-featured Nosved Player

## Relationships

- **Nosved Player** (full version): mpv-android engine with deep customization, network streaming, full yt-dlp integration, watch history, and advanced player controls.
- **Nosved Player Lite**: UI-focused variant with ExoPlayer engine, basic network streaming, and a lighter feature set.

## Core Features

### Playback

- mpv-android engine for broader codec support and stronger playback flexibility
- Local video playback with folder browsing
- Network stream playback for direct URLs
- Android share-intent support (open videos from other apps)

### Player Controls

- Large Player Settings side sheet for playback configuration
- Subtitle and audio track selection with speed/style controls
- Chapter/segment support when available
- Swipe-to-seek with adjustable sensitivity
- Multi-finger gestures (pinch-to-zoom, speed-lock)
- Redesigned volume/brightness gestures with 200% volume boost
- Screen-awake during playback
- Auto-play next video

### Browsing & Discovery

- Modern Video List with folder browsing
- Search results with video info
- Orientation filters (All/Portrait/Landscape)
- Feed mode for vertical video browsing
- Watch history with Room persistence + progress overlays
- History screen with clear-all action
- Tags and file sharing

### Thumbnails & Metadata

- MediaStore-based thumbnail fetching with caching
- Multiple thumbnail strategies (Smart, First Frame, Embedded, etc.)
- Embedded artwork extraction (Matroska, etc.)
- Full metadata parsing with FPS chips

### File Management

- Recycle bin with restore/delete support
- Storage explorer with tree navigation
- Move/copy without MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE

### Streaming & YouTube

- yt-dlp integration with quality selection, installation checks, and settings
- Custom mpv.conf editor with autocomplete and help docs
- Network stream history with progress tracking

### Customization

- Control layout editor (portrait/landscape)
- Playback control repositioning (middle/bottom)
- Seek bar styles, gradients, vector options
- Smart enhance feature with mpv equalizer (saturation, contrast, brightness, gamma, hue)

## Key Improvements

### Performance

- Optimized MediaStore queries (faster lists, no unnecessary fallback reads)
- Faster thumbnail loading with caching
- Reduced player startup latency and I/O bottlenecks
- Improved navigation transitions

### Release Optimization

- Reduced APK size (removed unneeded binaries, R8 full mode, optimized font asset)
- Reliable yt-dlp binary extraction on Android
- Cleaner codebase structure

## Fixes

- Timestamp formatting bugs (future year corrections)
- Seekbar ghosting and scrolling stutter
- Player ANR and double-tap crash fixes
- Decoder fallback issues (HW/SW handling)
- Blank playback / audio-only after restart
- Screen-orientation lock + background audio edge cases
- Thumbnail-fetching crashes
- Scoped-storage file operation bugs
- Release-version specific bugs and native crashes

## Summary

Nosved Player v1.0.0 is the first official release of the full-featured mpv-powered video player with deep customization, network streaming, yt-dlp support, watch history, gesture controls, advanced metadata, and a polished Material 3 experience from browsing to playback.

# 🔥🔥 Nosved Player v1.2.0 is Here!
We've been hard at work making Nosved Player smarter, faster, and much more enjoyable to use. Version 1.2.0 brings massive improvements to how you manage your files, alongside some beautiful design refreshes and crucial bug fixes.

Here is everything new in this update:

## ✨ What's New
Smart Multi-Selection: You can now long-press on folders or videos to select multiple items at once! Once selected, a new action bar appears allowing you to Play All, Move, Copy, Delete, or Rename multiple files in one go.

* **All-New Custom Storage Explorer:** We've replaced the clunky system file picker with our own premium, custom-built Storage Explorer. Moving, copying, and creating folders is now faster and much more reliable.
* **Youtube like Player:** Experience local videos same UI as Youtube with best seek and and gestures (Dual Player UI)
* **Pick Up Where You Left Off:** Videos now consistently remember their last played position. When you open a video from anywhere in the app, it will seamlessly resume exactly where you stopped.

* **Detailed Folder Insights:** Select any folder and tap the "Info" icon to instantly see the total number of videos, aggregated folder size, creation date, and exact storage location.

## 🎨 UI & UX Updates
Redesigned View Settings: The View Settings menu (bottom sheet) has been completely overhauled! It now features a sleek 3x3 grid for metadata toggles, centered column selectors, and modern segmented buttons for layout options.

* **Glassmorphism Rename Dialog:** Renaming files and folders just got a visual upgrade. We’ve introduced a beautiful, modern rename dialog with rounded corners and no annoying character limits.

* **Improved "Continue Watching" History:** Added visual progress bars under videos in the list/grid views so you can see your watch progress at a glance.

* **Deleting a history item is now much cooler:** just long-press the card, and a slick, animated "Delete" button pops up right in the center.

The Home screen history list is now smartly limited to your 10 most recent videos to keep things clean.

* **Visual Polish:** Selected folders and videos now show a beautiful primary color highlight and a checkmark badge. We also added the official Nosved Player logo to the About screen!

## 🐛 Bug Fixes & Improvements:
* **Hidden Files Actually Show Up:** Fixed a major issue where the "Show Hidden Files" toggle wouldn't work. We built a custom background scanner to ensure videos in hidden folders (or .nomedia folders) are properly detected when you want them to be.

* **Zero-Byte Metadata Fix:** Fixed a bug where videos would incorrectly show "0:00" duration or "0 MB" size. The app now uses a multi-layered fallback system to guarantee accurate video lengths and file sizes.

* **Accurate Resolution & Frame Rate:** Cleaned up the video details. Resolutions now display cleanly (e.g., "1920x1080"), and frame rates show as whole numbers (e.g., "30 fps" instead of "30.0 fps" or weird 0 fps artifacts).

* **Flawless File Operations:** Moving and copying large files is now strictly verified byte-by-byte to prevent corrupted or "0-byte" files from appearing if a stream errors out.

* **Unified Bottom Action Bar:** Fixed an annoying bug where bottom bar actions (Move/Copy/Delete) would fail or do nothing depending on whether you were in "Files" or "Folders" view. It now works flawlessly across the entire app.

* **Navigation Fix:** Fixed an issue where hitting the "Back" button from the Settings menu would force you all the way back to the Home screen. It now correctly takes you to your previous screen.
